props.name: items
props.description: A collection of `Item` props and `Item`-level custom `Item` renderers.

props.name: title
props.description: A descriptive title for the panel

props.name: subtitle
props.description: When provided, a subtitle is displayed below the title

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text used in anchor when there are no selected items

props.name: placeholderText
props.description: Text used as placeholder for search input

props.name: inputLabel
props.description: The aria-label for the filter input

props.name: aria-label
props.description: aria-label to attach to the base DOM node of the list

props.name: filterValue
props.description: The current value of the search input

props.name: selected
props.description: Specify the selected item(s)

props.name: open
props.description: Determines whether the overlay portion of the component should be shown or not

props.name: anchorId
props.description: An override to the internal id that will be spread on to the renderAnchor

props.name: anchorRef
props.description:
An override to the internal renderAnchor ref that will be used to position the overlay.
When renderAnchor is null this can be used to make an anchor that is detached from ActionMenu.
An override to the internal ref that will be spread on to the renderAnchor

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Provide a callback called when the selected item(s) change

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Callback when the search input changes

props.name: onCancel
props.description: (Narrow screens and variant=modal) Callback when the user hits cancel or close

props.name: overlayProps
props.description: See [Overlay props](/react/Overlay#props).

props.name: textInputProps
props.description: See [TextInput props](/react/TextInput#props).

props.name: variant
props.description: Anchored by default, SelectPanel can be opened as a modal

props.name: footer
props.description: Please use `secondaryAction` instead.

props.name: message
props.type: {title: string | React.ReactElement; variant: 'empty' | 'error' | 'warning';  body: React.ReactNode; icon?:React.ComponentType<IconProps>;action?: React.ReactElement;}
props.defaultValue: A default empty message is provided if this option is not configured. Supply a custom empty message to override the default.
props.description: Message to display in the panel in case of error or empty results

props.name: notice
props.description: Optional notice to display on top of the panel

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: Secondary action, it will be rendered in the footer of the panel. Use `SecondaryActionButton` or `SecondaryActionLink` for the action.

props.name: showSelectedOptionsFirst
props.description: Whether to display the selected items at the top of the list

props.name: showSelectAll
props.description: When `true` and on a multi-select SelectPanel, displays a 'Select all' checkbox that allows users to select or deselect all visible items at once. The checkbox label automatically toggles between 'Select all' and 'Deselect all' based on the current selection state, and shows an indeterminate state when some items are selected.

props.name: disableFullscreenOnNarrow
props.description: Whether to disable fullscreen behavior on narrow viewports. When `true`, the panel will maintain its anchored position regardless of viewport size. When `false`, the panel will go fullscreen on narrow viewports (if feature flag is enabled).

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the panel is in a loading state. When `true`, the panel will display a loading spinner. If `loading` is not provided, the panel will infer the loading state based on the contents of `items` available.

props.name: align
props.description: Determines the alignment of the panel relative to the anchor. Defaults to 'start' which aligns the left edge of the panel with the left edge of the anchor.

props.name: scrollContainerRef
props.description: A ref assigned to the scrollable container wrapping the ActionList

props.name: actionListProps
props.description: See [ActionList props](/react/ActionList#props).

props.name: focusOutBehavior
props.description: Determines how keyboard focus behaves when navigating beyond the first or last item in the list.

props.name: onActiveDescendantChanged
props.type: (newActiveDescendant: HTMLElement | undefined, previousActiveDescendant: HTMLElement | undefined, directlyActivated: boolean) => void | undefined
props.description: Callback function that is called when the active descendant changes.

props.name: virtualized
props.description: If true, enables client-side list virtualization. Only the visible items plus a small overscan buffer are rendered in the DOM, dramatically improving performance for large lists. Recommended for lists with more than 100 items. Has no effect when `groupMetadata` is provided.

props.name: displayInViewport
props.description: If true, the panel will attempt to fit entirely into the visible viewport, without having to scroll.
